messages:
Nisha K.: Pushing the pen-test + vuln-scan package for Acme's vendor risk review. Zipped repo includes: pen-test-report.pdf, nessus_export.xml, nmap_scan.txt, remediation-tracker.csv (owner/team/ETA), per-issue evidence, and attestation draft. S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_vendor_docs_1789123456.zip
SHA256: d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5

SecurityBot: Automated scan summary: tools = Nessus Pro, nmap 7.93. Findings: 1 CRITICAL (open RDP), 4 HIGH, 10 MEDIUM, 6 LOW. remediation-tracker.csv contains CVE refs and suggested mitigations. :mag_right:

Omar B.: Sales asks for explicit columns: owner, responsible team, ETA (YYYY-MM-DD), change-request link, and oncall contact. Also Acme requested an InfoSec-signed attestation confirming no customer data exposure. Can we provide that?

Nisha K.: Yes. I added the requested columns in remediation-tracker.csv and included a draft attestation at /attestation/acme_attestation_draft.pdf addressed to "Acme Corp (security@acme.example)". We will GPG-sign and add a PDF timestamp. Sample rows from the tracker (full file in zip):
```
issue_id,short_desc,severity,owner,team,eta,change_req,oncall
PT-900,Exposed RDP on bastion,CRITICAL,Renee T.,Infra,2026-04-01,CHG-8120,oncall@redwood.com
PT-914,Outdated OpenSSL,HIGH,Infra Ops,Infra,2026-04-08,CHG-8121,oncall@redwood.com
PT-922,Missing CSP header,MEDIUM,Web Eng,Frontend,2026-04-05,CHG-8122,oncall@redwood.com
```

Renee T.: Notes on PT-900: RDP (3389) observed open to 0.0.0.0/0 on a bastion host due to an incorrect terraform network rule. Mitigation plan: 1) remove broad rule, 2) restrict to management CIDRs, 3) enforce session broker (SSM) and rotate keys. I can schedule the change in the 02:00-03:00 UTC maintenance window tonight and validate. ETA 2026-04-01 to allow testing and rollback plan. Evidence files: PT-900-rdp-screenshot.png, PT-900-firewall-rule-before.txt, PT-900-validation-after.txt.

Omar B.: Please include the exact verification commands and the test checklist in the tracker so Acme can reproduce the validation. Also Sales wants a two-sentence customer-facing summary and confirmation we will respond to clarifying questions within 48 hours.

Nisha K.: Added verification snippets to the tracker and sample commands, e.g., `sudo ufw status numbered` and `nmap -p 3389 -Pn <bastion-ip>`. Draft customer summary: "Redwood completed an external pen-test and vulnerability scan for your environment. One critical finding has been scheduled for immediate remediation; remediation ownership, timelines, and supporting evidence are attached, along with an InfoSec-signed attestation confirming no customer data exposure."

Renee T.: I'll attach the post-change validation outputs to the evidence folder after the maintenance run. I'll also open CHG-8120 with the change board notes and include rollback steps.

SecurityBot: Reminder: default retention for security artifacts = 90 days. If legal requires longer retention, open a retention ticket in #legal-retention.

Omar B.: Sales will send this bundle to Acme tomorrow 09:00 PT. Please ensure the attestation is signed and the tracker has oncall contact visible. I'll include CHG-8120 and the S3 link in the email.

Nisha K.: Will sign the attestation and update the zip with a v2 suffix once signed. New S3 path will be versioned and not deleted until legal signs off. Closing thread unless there are objections.
